title.english: The Work in Another Pair of Hands

pairs.target: wēn xiù jiāng dìèrzhī tuōjià cóng xiè jià páng tuīchū láishí , tǎ wéi xiān kàn tā dǐxià yǒuméiyǒu xīn mó hén .
pairs.english: As Wenxiu pushed the second cradle from beside the unloading rack, Tavi checked beneath it for new wear.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫将第二只托架从卸架旁推出来时，塔维先看它底下有没有新磨痕。

pairs.target: tā méi ràng tā cāi , jiào tā fān jìlù : jiētóu yǔ chǐcùn chá guò , dì miànshì fàng zuò guò , kōngxiāng hé xiàndìng qīngzǎi de shìyùn yě yǐ fēnbié zǒu wán , búshì tā huílái le cái hūrán néng yòng .
pairs.english: She had him read the records, not guess: joints, dimensions, ground rehearsals, and separate empty-crate and restricted light-load trials were complete, not suddenly usable because he'd returned.
pairs.hanzi: 她没让他猜，叫他翻记录：接头与尺寸查过，地面试放做过，空箱和限定轻载的试运也已分别走完，不是他回来了才忽然能用。

pairs.target: yuánlái nà zhī réng liúzài shí bèi . liǎngtóu gè yǒu yìzhī , huí kōngxiāng shí biàn búbì zài jiāng kuān jià sāijìn tàodié de xiāngzǐ lǐ .
pairs.english: The original stayed at Shibei. One at each end meant no more stuffing a wide cradle among nested returning empty crates.
pairs.hanzi: 原来那只仍留在石背。两头各有一只，回空箱时便不必再将宽架塞进套叠的箱子里。

pairs.target: duō chūlái de mùliào , fàng jià de dìfāng hé zhàoliào de rén réng zài zhàng shàng , mù guǎnshì nàyàng de huòzhàn ruò ná biéde xiāngdǐ lái , bùnéng yīn jiàzi duō le yìzhī biàn dōu zhàozhe zǒu .
pairs.english: Extra timber, storage space, and staff still counted as costs; a warehouse like Mou's bringing a different crate base couldn't use it merely because another cradle existed.
pairs.hanzi: 多出来的木料、放架的地方和照料的人仍在账上，牟管事那样的货栈若拿别的箱底来，不能因架子多了一只便都照着走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rèn le jìlù shàng jǐchù bùtóng de zì , jì huái jì shí , tóng lái de lìng yíwèi gōngrén jì xièxià hòu de yìnhén .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized different hands in the record: Ji Huai timing, another worker noting marks after unloading.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认了记录上几处不同的字，纪槐记时，同来的另一位工人记卸下后的印痕。

pairs.target: tā zhǐzhe yíchù qīngqīng fāmáo de mù biān , wèn shìfǒu yǐjīng chǔlǐ guò , wēn xiù ràng tā kàn hòu yè , nàlǐ guǒrán liú zhe páo qù báobáo yìcéng yǐhòu zhòng chá de shù .
pairs.english: He asked about a slightly rough wooden edge. Wenxiu showed the next page, with rechecked readings after planing away a thin layer.
pairs.hanzi: 他指着一处轻轻发毛的木边，问是否已经处理过，温岫让他看后页，那里果然留着刨去薄薄一层以后重查的数。

pairs.target: tā jīnrì yào zhuāng de què búshì zhè zhī jià . pángbiān zhuōshàng fàng zhe yíjiàn jiázhù mù liáng bì de kǎkòu , hélǒng shí zhǎi kǒu yǎo dé tàijǐn , xū zài zhuāngpèi shí ràng yìzhī xiǎo xiāo chuān guòqù , chuān hǎo yǐhòu kào xiāo hé kòutóu zìjǐ liúzhù wèizhì .
pairs.english: Today's assembly wasn't this cradle but a clasp for a wooden measuring arm. Its narrow mouth gripped too tightly; a small pin inserted during assembly would afterwards hold the position mechanically with the pin and clasp head.
pairs.hanzi: 她今日要装的却不是这只架。旁边桌上放着一件夹住木量臂的卡扣，合拢时窄口咬得太紧，须在装配时让一只小销穿过去，穿好以后靠销和扣头自己留住位置。

pairs.target: nà liǎngkuài néng jiè xìng de tiě shì zuōfang dàilái de gōngjù , bìng búshì yào bǎ zhěngzhī kǎ kòuliú chéng yíjiàn huì zìxíng biànruǎn de dōngxī .
pairs.english: The borrowable irons were workshop tools, not a way to leave the entire clasp self-softening.
pairs.hanzi: 那两块能借性的铁是作坊带来的工具，并不是要把整只卡扣留成一件会自行变软的东西。

pairs.target: wēn xiù jiāng mù tái tóng wǎnglái huòwù gékāi , jiào tǎ wéi zhàn dào néng kàn biǎo , yòu bù dǎng lìng yíwèi zhuāngpèi shīfu shēnshǒu de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Wenxiu isolated the wooden bench from freight traffic, placing Tavi where he could see the gauges without blocking the assembly craftsman's reach.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫将木台同往来货物隔开，叫塔维站到能看表、又不挡另一位装配师傅伸手的地方。

pairs.target: tā xiān hé zhè duì tiěliào de xiāngróngxìng yǔ zhěngkuài tǐjī , chá qiǎn cáo , jiēchùmiàn , qīngzǎi hé zhǐ dǎng , yòu jiāng liǎngbiān wèi jiè shí de shù dú guò yìhuí . liǎngkuài tiě dōu hěnxiǎo , què yě bùnéng zhī píng kànzhe chàbùduō , biàn shuō yǐjīng héshì .
pairs.english: She checked the pair's material compatibility and whole volumes, grooves, contact patches, light loads, stops, and both baseline readings. Small irons couldn't be judged suitable just by looking alike.
pairs.hanzi: 她先核这对铁料的相容性与整块体积，查浅槽、接触面、轻载和止挡，又将两边未借时的数读过一回。两块铁都很小，却也不能只凭看着差不多，便说已经合适。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de nà duì tiě tóng jiājù hái zài xuégōng , tā jīnrì dài de shì zhǐ hé zìjǐ de chǐ . wēn xiù méiyǒu cóng gōngjù hélǐ tiāo yíkuài gěi tā shìshǒu , zhī ràng tā bǎ zhuāngpèi shīfu yào zǒu de nàtiáo shǒu lù huà chūlái , xiāo zài nǎbiān ná , chuānguò yǐhòu shǒu cóng nǎlǐ tuì , bùtóng shōuhuí jiēchù de dìfāng xiāngzhuàng .
pairs.english: Tavi's iron pair and fixture were still at the academy; he had paper and his own ruler. Wenxiu didn't offer a new iron to try, only asked him to draw the craftsman's hand route: picking up the pin, inserting and withdrawing clear of both recontact paths.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的那对铁同夹具还在学宫，他今日带的是纸和自己的尺。温岫没有从工具盒里挑一块给他试手，只让他把装配师傅要走的那条手路画出来，销在哪边拿，穿过以后手从哪里退，不同收回接触的地方相撞。

pairs.target: dìyīzhāng tā huà dé tài tiējìn bǎichuí . shīfu shēn zhǐ bǐ le yíxià , shuō zìjǐ shǒubèi kě méiyǒu zhǐ zhème báo . tǎ wéi jiāng wèizhì yíkāi , chóngxīn kàn xiāo jiān cháoxiàng , cái míngbái hǎo huà chūlái de yìgēn zhíxiàn , rén wèibì néng zhàozhe shēnjìnqù .
pairs.english: His first drawing ran too close to the pendulum. The craftsman showed his hand wasn't paper-thin. Tavi moved the position and rechecked the pin tip's direction, realizing an easily drawn straight line wasn't always a usable hand path.
pairs.hanzi: 第一张他画得太贴近摆锤。师傅伸指比了一下，说自己手背可没有纸这么薄。塔维将位置移开，重新看销尖朝向，才明白好画出来的一根直线，人未必能照着伸进去。

pairs.target: wēn xiù děng tā gǎi wán , zìjǐ yòu chá guò , cái jiāng shuāngshǒu fàngdào nà duì tiě shàng . liǎngbiān de tánxìng xiǎngyìng yì zēng yì jiǎn , qīngzǎi xià de zhǐzhēn gèzì yí guò hé hǎo de xiǎofú .
pairs.english: After his revision and her own recheck, Wenxiu contacted both irons. Their elastic responses increased and decreased complementarily, the light-load pointers moving within checked small ranges.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫等他改完，自己又查过，才将双手放到那对铁上。两边的弹性响应一增一减，轻载下的指针各自移过核好的小幅。

pairs.target: tā méi wǎng dà chù zhuī , quèrèn hòu táishǒu , shīfu suíjí jiāng xiāo chārù , dìyīshēng bǎi xiǎng hái méi dào , shǒu yǐ tuìchū .
pairs.english: She didn't push further. Once verified she lifted her hands; the craftsman inserted the pin and withdrew before the first pendulum click.
pairs.hanzi: 她没往大处追，确认后抬手，师傅随即将销插入，第一声摆响还没到，手已退出。

pairs.target: tā liǎngshǒu yìtóng chóngxīn jiē huí tiěmiàn , shōuhuí jiè xìng , qīngzǎi de dúshù huídào jīxiàn , xièxià zài chá , yě huí dé zhèngcháng .
pairs.english: She recontacted both iron surfaces together, canceled the borrowing, and verified light-load baseline readings, then normal return after unloading.
pairs.hanzi: 她两手一同重新接回铁面，收回借性，轻载的读数回到基线，卸下再查，也回得正常。

pairs.target: xiāo réng chuān zài kòu lǐ , mù liáng bì de wèizhì kào nà yìdiǎn shízài de zhuāngpèi liú zhe . tǎ wéi yìzhí wàng zhe xiāo , zhídào wēn xiù jiāng kǎkòu tóng liǎngkuài tiě fēn kāifàng , cái fājué zìjǐ fāngcái yě píng le yìkǒuqì .
pairs.english: The pin remained in the clasp, mechanically holding the wooden measuring arm's position. Tavi watched until Wenxiu separated clasp and irons, then realized he'd held his breath.
pairs.hanzi: 销仍穿在扣里，木量臂的位置靠那一点实在的装配留着。塔维一直望着销，直到温岫将卡扣同两块铁分开放，才发觉自己方才也屏了一口气。

pairs.target: " búshì jiào nǐ tì wǒ biēqì . " tā shuō , " gāi jì de shùjì le méiyǒu ? "
pairs.english: “You weren't meant to hold your breath for me,” she said. “Did you get the readings?”
pairs.hanzi: “不是叫你替我憋气。”她说，“该记的数记了没有？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gǎnjǐn dītóu , fāxiànzìjǐ zài shīfu tuì shǒu nà yì gé huà le gè xiǎoquān , shù què méi lòu . tā jiāng dúshù niàn gěi tā , niànwán cái wèn , zìjǐ shénme shíhòu cáinéng huàn biéde gōngjù zuò , bù zhǐshì kàn tóng yíjiàn jiājù .
pairs.english: Tavi found he'd circled the withdrawal box without missing any numbers. He read them aloud, then asked when he could use different tools rather than the same fixture.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维赶紧低头，发现自己在师傅退手那一格画了个小圈，数却没漏。他将读数念给她，念完才问，自己什么时候才能换别的工具做，不只是看同一件夹具。

pairs.target: wēn xiù jiāng gōngjù hégài shàng yíbàn , méi shuō duō zuò jǐhuí zìrán jiù néng . tā shuō zìjǐ dāngchū yě jí zhe huàn , hòulái yǒu yízhèn zhī huì huàn xīn dōngxī , bùkěn bǎ jiù wèntí zuò wán , shīfu mà dé zuì hěn de shì tā lián zìjǐ zài nǎ yíbù kànlòu dōu shuōbùchū .
pairs.english: Wenxiu half-closed the toolbox without promising practice alone would do it. She'd rushed to change too, once always trying new things instead of finishing old problems; her teacher's worst scolding was for not knowing which step she'd missed.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫将工具盒盖上一半，没说多做几回自然就能。她说自己当初也急着换，后来有一阵只会换新东西，不肯把旧问题做完，师傅骂得最狠的是她连自己在哪一步看漏都说不出。

pairs.target: shuōwán yòu bǔ , shīfu màrén bìng bù zǒng yǒu dàolǐ , zuì ài bǎ liǎngnián qián de jiùshì yě fānchūlái .
pairs.english: She added that the teacher wasn't always fair and loved dredging up two-year-old mistakes too.
pairs.hanzi: 说完又补，师傅骂人并不总有道理，最爱把两年前的旧事也翻出来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le , tā yě xiào , ràng tā bǎ jīntiān zhè tiáo shǒu lù tóng shuǐbiān nàxiē ràng rén zhuǎnshēn de kòngdì fàngdào yíchù kànkàn . nà shì néng wèn huí xuégōng de jùtǐ wèntí , búshì yìzhāng wǎnghòu shénme gōngjù dōu néng pèng de tōngxíng zhǐ .
pairs.english: They laughed. She suggested comparing today's hand route with the riverside spaces for turning: a concrete question for the academy, not permission for every tool thereafter.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了，她也笑，让他把今天这条手路同水边那些让人转身的空地放到一处看看。那是能问回学宫的具体问题，不是一张往后什么工具都能碰的通行纸。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn ruǎn héng huílái , liǎng rén chīfàn shí , tǎ wéi bǎ zhège wèntí chóngxīn shuō le yíbiàn . ruǎn héng méi lìkè gěi yíjiàn xīn jiājù , zhī dāying xiàhuí jì jìn xuégōng de shí zuò jìlù , huì liántóng tā huà de shǒu lù yìqǐ sòng , qǐng wéi lǎoshī kàn tā jiēxiàlái gāibǔ nǎxiàng .
pairs.english: At dinner Tavi put the question to Ruan Heng, who offered no new fixture immediately but promised to send the hand-route sketch with the next placement report for Instructor Vey to assess the next learning step.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚阮衡回来，两人吃饭时，塔维把这个问题重新说了一遍。阮衡没立刻给一件新夹具，只答应下回寄进学宫的实作记录，会连同他画的手路一起送，请维老师看他接下来该补哪项。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng nà yè shōu hǎo , kǎkòu yǐjīng jiāogěi yào yòng de rén , zhuōshàng zhōngyú zhī shèng fànwǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi put away the page. The clasp had gone to its user; only dinner bowls remained on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将那页收好，卡扣已经交给要用的人，桌上终于只剩饭碗。
